Alec: Heads-up — nightly eval (convo-qa promptset) shows a major regression for grove-7b-quant after last night's attn-layout merge (commit abc1234f). pass rate down ~18%, sampling entropy dropped ~0.9 nats. suspect attention layout change interacting with sampler/state ordering. :eyes:
Maya (eng-runtime): link to the PR/commit? which nightly job ran this? any quick repro commands?
Alec: PR https://github.com/redwood/rtf/pull/984 commit abc1234f. Nightly job: jobs/nightly-quant-02/2026-03-18. Reproduced locally (linux, same docker image) with this command:
```
python experiments/run_eval.py \
  --model grove-7b-quant \
  --commit abc1234f \
  --prompts eval_sets/convo-qa.jsonl \
  --seed 42 \
  --batch 1 \
  --sampling top_k=40,temperature=0.9
```
Alec: Attaching a small before/after excerpt — baseline (pre-merge) vs post-merge generations: repeated short phrases, lower lexical variety.
```
# baseline (pre-merge)
Assistant: Sure — here's the plan: step one ... step two ... then confirm.
# after merge
Assistant: Sure. Sure. Sure. Sure. Sure. Sure. Sure.
```
Jonah: can you paste softmax logits or topk probs for an example token where it collapsed?
Alec: here's log from debug run (token 34 probs):
```
TopK tokens: [540, 12, 76, 999, ...]
Probs: [0.915, 0.034, 0.021, 0.010, ...]
Entropy: 0.48 nats
Baseline entropy (same prompt/seed): 1.42 nats
```
Maya (eng-runtime): that pattern screams state misordering — if KV write/read order changed in attn-layout refactor, sampler that depends on incremental cache could be reading stale or misaligned logits -> picks very peaky top. Did the refactor change prefetch or kv-write timing?
eng-ci-bot: CI: deploy abc1234f -> infra-03 completed (2026-03-18T02:14Z). Nightly run artifacts: https://ci.internal/jobs/nightly-quant-02/2190013579/artifacts
Alec: quick experiment: set env SAMPLER_COMPAT=1 (compat shim to preserve old KV read order) and rerun. Result: pass rate back within 2% of baseline, entropy restored. So it's reproducible and togglable.
Maya (eng-runtime): good repro. sounds like sampler <-> kv/cache ordering. Can you run with --no-prefetch and with --force-old-kv-order to confirm? Also please attach a minimal reproducer and the seed-specific waveforms.
Alec: did --no-prefetch + --force-old-kv-order, same fix. Filed triage ticket T-9921 with logs, artifacts, and repro steps. gist: https://gist.internal/repodumps/2190013579
Jonah: I'll schedule a rollback of the attn-layout merge on the hosted canary and block further rollouts until we fix. If SAMPLER_COMPAT is a cheap toggle we can roll that to prod as a stopgap. :thumbsup:
Maya (eng-runtime): next steps: 1) add unit/regression test in nightly pipeline that compares sampling entropy for canonical prompts across merges; 2) bisect exact line in attn-layout that changed kv write order; 3) design a robust kv-read invariant in runtime so sampler can't observe partially-updated state. I'll take lead on (2) today.
Alec: thanks — boosting priority. for record, triage ticket T-9921 created and linked to PR revert request: https://github.com/redwood/rtf/pull/988 (revert flag + hotfix).
Jonah: adding to canary queue now, pinging @Maya when rollback is ready.
Alec: adding sample artifacts to the eval dashboard and tagging infra/sre.
Maya (eng-runtime): :bug: thanks. once we have a tiny reproducer I'll open a focused test in nightly-eval harness so we catch this earlier.
eng-ci-bot: Note: nightly alerts suppressed for the revert canary deploy until changes stabilize.
